user.title: Label Based Features
user.description: Configure a Labeled Features instance. Leaders, features, and followers stay label-driven; only instance-level settings live here.

data_description.instance_name: Display-only. Rename freely without affecting entity IDs.
data_description.features_entity_id: Fully overridable. Defaults to sensor.labeled_features_state (matches the legacy template sensor).
data_description.leader_label: The label name that identifies leader entities and areas. Defaults to feature_leader.
data_description.alert_action: Called by the alert error tier with alert_severity/alert_title/alert_message. Default script.send_alert.
data_description.script_call_mode: Instance default for script dispatch. Per-feature overrides continue to be read from labels on the Features sensor.

reconfigure.title: Label Based Features
reconfigure.description: Update the instance name, sensor entity IDs, or instance-level settings. Changing entity IDs reloads the platform.

error.entity_id_invalid: Entity ID must match sensor.<slug> (lowercase, digits, single underscores; no leading, trailing, or double underscores).
error.entity_id_taken: Another integration or template sensor is already using this entity ID. Remove that first, or choose a different ID (e.g. add a _dev suffix).
error.entity_id_duplicate: The two sensor entity IDs must be different from each other.
error.alert_action_invalid: Alert action must be in the form domain.name (e.g. script.send_alert).
error.leader_label_required: The leader label name is required.

abort.already_configured: This combination of leader label and features sensor is already configured.

error.alert_action_invalid: Alert action must be in the form domain.name.
error.leader_label_required: The leader label name is required.

scope_id.name: Scope ID
scope_id.description: The area_id, floor_id, or empty string for global.

set_snapshot.name: Set Snapshot
set_snapshot.description: Write a snapshot payload into sensor.labeled_features_state.snapshots (empty payload deletes).

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Mapping payload. Pass an empty mapping to delete.
